status: framework integration smoke run, not an optimized benchmark
controls: all known controls shared within experiment
normalization: mean single-cell log1p CP10K minus same-day control mean
unit: target/guide/day population, not paired cells or biological replicates
cohort_selection: cell counts only, common across guides; response values not used to select cohort
mainline: actual-time observations -> IDOP binary candidate topology -> independently estimated propagation -> forecast and source inversion
fixed_configuration: alpha .1; adjacent two-timepoint windows; strict frequency > .6; dynamical ridge .1; signed stable propagation
prediction: opposite guide day2 full51 state plus known source -> days3,4,5 marker responses
tracing: opposite guide days2,3,4,5, 28 non-target sensors only; unknown day2 full state treated as a common ridge nuisance
tracing_time_scope: continued persistent input over observed day2-5 interval; onset time not inferred
limits: candidate graph is not causal proof
framework smoke metrics are not evidence of superiority
